text: On June 8, 2021, City Council adopted item MM34.6 - "Exploring Development Opportunities at 1169 Weston Road and 4 Hollis Street" and requested CreateTO, in consultation with City staff and the Toronto Parking Authority, to explore the development opportunities of the City-owned real estate assets known as 1169 Weston Road and 4 Hollis Street. The development opportunities were to include the following: · a mixed-use development that provides a variety of community benefits and with the potential inclusion of private land holdings within the immediate vicinity; · working with the Toronto Parking Authority to identify new parking opportunities in both on and off street locations suitable for replacement of parking spaces within the vicinity of the proposed development, should an investment in parking on-site be deemed not feasible; and · working with City Planning and Parks, Forestry,…

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Authorized the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO to negotiate a conditional term sheet and conditional agreement of purchase and sale of the City-owned Property at 1169 Weston Road, with the adjacent Private Landowner based on the strategic plan outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 6, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO; and report back to the Board of Directors of CreateTO on the outcomes of these negotiations by the first quarter 2023. 2. Directed the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, in consultation with the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management, the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, the Executive Director, Housing Secretariat and any other divisions necessary to advance this opportunity, to explore the strategic opportunities identified within Confidential Attachment 1 to the…
